concepts.gloss_en: Heel (akev/ekev), the aspect of feet/legs and of judgment (din), associated with Yaakov

reason_for_human: All five occurrences are the single word 'heel' (root ע-ק-ב) — the vocalizations עֲקֵבַיִם (dual), עָקֵב, and עֵקֶב are just number/pausal inflections of one word, not homographs, so per protocol they are one concept. The 'distinct local equations' the round-1 split relied on (din, raglin, dal, Yaakov) are all the same coherent heel→feet→judgment→Yaakov theme, not evidence of different words. Recommend merging the singular and plural into one concept.
